epics.title: Production Containerization & Health Inspection Orchestration
epics.jtbd: When an operator or automated delivery supervisor deploys the knowledge base platform, I want a root-level docker-compose specification starting the complete stack with an integrated health check, so that platform readiness and live runtime behavior can be verified reliably.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Container cold-start and health check pass rate >= 99.9%
requirements: R1: Root-level docker-compose.yml defining the full application service stack
R2: Service definition exposing the FastAPI application and mapping appropriate port 8097
R3: Integrated Docker container healthcheck pinging /api/v1/health with timeout and retry policies

slices.title: Add Root Docker Compose Configuration with Healthcheck Probe
slices.jtbd: When packaging the platform for local and remote deployment, I want a root docker-compose.yml file with container healthcheck configuration, so that the service stack can be booted and verified deterministically.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the repository root directory,
When docker-compose up is executed,
Then the crie-assistant container starts and mounts or serves the application on port 8097.

Given the running crie-assistant container,
When Docker polls the container healthcheck command against /api/v1/health,
Then the healthcheck status transitions to healthy within 30 seconds.

epics.title: Runtime Environment Health Check & Launch Failure Remediation
epics.jtbd: When the automated execution environment clones and assesses repository health, I want the missing root orchestration file defect resolved with reproducible launch validation, so that runtime observation succeeds without missing manifest errors.
requirements: R1: Remedy 'docker-compose.yml not found at repo root after clone' runtime failure
R2: Verify environment startup and /api/v1/health response under container runtime

slices.title: Validate and Patch Repo Root Compose Runtime Readiness
slices.jtbd: When diagnosing the recorded launcher failure, I want to ensure the repository root contains an executable docker-compose.yml and Dockerfile that successfully boots the FastAPI service, so that runtime observation passes cleanly.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a fresh repository clone,
When checking the filesystem root,
Then docker-compose.yml is present and valid.

Given the launcher inspects runtime container health,
When inspecting container status after boot,
Then the container reports status healthy with HTTP 200 from /api/v1/health.
